reason: Entity search lists must be read from DB each cycle, not frozen at startup, so new entities are picked up immediately and well-covered entities are deprioritized by opinion count. This fixes the gotcha where 5358 entities existed but only 216 were ever searched because the list was frozen once at first run.
Operator asked crawler to focus on products; implemented via SEARCH_PRIORITY_FOCUS_TYPES, which must be set and recreated on all four hosts. Rule belongs in this skill.
Description must name the product-focus trigger so the skill is recalled for that request.
